title: security(rbac): enforce KMS region residency and harden audit logging for RBAC V2
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: As part of our RBAC v2 rollout and ongoing compliance work, customers requested stronger guarantees around KMS key residency and richer audit trails for KMS-related actions. This PR enforces KMS region residency constraints at policy-evaluation time, improves audit logging for all KMS policy decisions, and adds a migration to backfill enforcement metadata for existing resources. Motivation: prevent accidental cross-region KMS key usage, make policy violations auditable, and give SREs clear signals when residency constraints block operations. Summary of changes: - Add KMS region residency check to RBAC v2 policy evaluator. The check rejects requests where the requested KMS key region does not satisfy the resource's residency policy. - Enrich audit logs with residency decision fields (requested_region, resource_residency, policy_id, decision_reason). Audit messages are emitted for allow/deny and for fallbacks. - Add a fail-open configurable toggle for 7 days rollout; default is "enforce" for new installs and "audit" for upgrades. - Migration script to annotate existing KMS attachments with residency metadata and to seed audit events for resources that would have been denied. - Integration tests and unit tests covering region mismatch, missing region metadata, and fail-open behavior. - Docs: security/kms-region-residency.md with rollout guidance and operator steps. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-4532) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests in CI - [x] Migration tested locally against staging DB - [x] Docs updated - [x] Security scan run (no severe findings) Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main with default upgrade behavior set to "audit" so upgrades do not immediately break customer workflows. 2) Observe audit volume and fix edge cases for 2 weeks. 3) Enable enforcement for new clusters by default and schedule customer-facing enforcement with 30-day notice for existing customers. Backward compatibility: the default for upgrades is audit-only; operators can flip enforcement via cluster config or the Console. Testing notes: unit coverage added for evaluator, new e2e integration that exercises a simulated cross-region key request, and a migration smoke test. CI: integration tests run against a seeded KMS emulator and passed in staging. Security considerations: tightened IAM roles required by the policy evaluator process; minimal privileges are documented in the installer notes. Migration note: the migration seeds an "rbac_residency_v1" column on resources and writes a small audit event batch; the migration is idempotent and has a dry-run flag. Related: SUP-1123 (customer support escalations), ENG-4532 (design), SEC-891 (security review).

review_comments: Ethan Zhang: Can you clarify how we represent region for multi-key resources? Suggested adding fallback to resource-level locality if key-level region is missing.
Asha Patel: Reply: evaluator now falls back to resource.residency when key.region is missing; added unit tests for fallback behavior.
María Gomez: Please ensure audit events do not contain customer PII. I see key ARNs are currently emitted in full.
Asha Patel: Reply: scrubbed key ARNs in audit payloads; full ARNs written to internal secure audit store only when debug mode is enabled and operator consented.
Liam O'Connor: Minor: add a short note in the migration about rollback steps; otherwise LGTM.
Asha Patel: Added rollback guidance to migration script and docs.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency checks in RBAC v2 evaluator and harden audit logging for KMS-related decisions. Adds migration to annotate existing resources and seed audit events. Upgrade default: audit-only for existing clusters; enforcement for new installs.
